# @suluk/admin

> The /superadmin web admin panel — the same cockpit as the vscode extension (@suluk/cockpit core), rendered as a Hono-served web UI. Superadmin-gated. CANDIDATE tooling.

> Reference tooling for the OpenAPI v4.0 Suluk candidate.

### API

- `adminApp`: Build the /superadmin Hono app. Mount it on your server: `app.route("/", adminApp({...}))`.
- `layout`
- `renderCycle`
- `renderBuilder`
- `renderChecks`
- `renderDeploy`
- `esc`
- `entityModels`: Project a v4 document's component schemas into admin entity models (fields + per-CRUD access scope), sorted.
- `renderEntityForm`: A create/edit form for an entity, derived from its schema. `id` is omitted on create (DB-assigned).
- `renderEntityTable`: A list table for an entity — a column per field; `rows` are optional sample data to fill it.
- `renderDataIndex`: The data-admin index: every CRUD-managed entity + its access scopes, linking to its per-entity page.
- `renderEntityAdmin`: One entity's data-admin page — a FULLY FUNCTIONAL CRUD UI (saastarter's Payload admin, projected): a live list
table (loaded from the entity's CRUD...
- `renderAnalytics`: Render the analytics dashboard for a document.

## Optional

### Types

- `EntityModel`
- `EntityField`
- `EntityAccess`
